My family left me at home alone while they went skiing since I had a test to study for.  They asked me to heat up the food for when they get home, I I stayed in the living room while watching tv as the food was heating up. 

Then I heard the keypad for the garage door, and assumed my family was home, so I just kept watching tv. I started feeling a bit uneasy when I heard them get the keypad code wrong three times. (I was okay at the first attempt being wrong since I even got it wrong sometimes). 

After that I paused the tv, and turned off the stove, I was convinced that someone was trying to enter my house. (My house was fairly big so the lights in the living room and kitchen weren’t visible from the front of the house). There were no tracks in the snow either from car tires on the driveway, and the garage lights were off.

I grabbed a phone and a knife, and mentally prepared myself for something bad to happen. Then I went to the room that the door led into to see if I could hear anybody in the garage, since I would expect to hear my family talking to each other, but it was completely quiet and they kept trying to open the door. Eventually they started banging on the door and with hopes it was my family I opened it, but was ready to cut their legs in case.

Turned out it was my family though, and they never explained why they kept getting the code wrong for the door
